# Dynamics 365 F&O — DMF / Data Management Monitoring

Converted from Microsoft FastTrack DMF ADX dashboard for **Azure Monitor Workbooks**. Directly queries your selected **Application Insights** resource; no standalone ADX cluster is required.

Select a **Custom time interval** (for example 1:00–2:00 PM) to investigate data-project imports/exports, entity records, durations, error messages, and incomplete telemetry. Blank filters include all values. Results reflect **observed telemetry**, not authoritative status in F&O. A missing End event may mean processing is ongoing, delayed, or that telemetry was dropped.

**First-run validation:** Verify `DMF*` events exist in Application Insights, the customDimensions keys match your F&O version, and dashboard values match Data Management execution history. Large time windows cause higher query load.

content.query:
let allDMFEvents = (
customEvents
| where name startswith "DMF"
| where timestamp between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end} )
| extend cd = parse_json(customDimensions)
| extend BatchJobCaption = tostring( cd.BatchJobCaption)
| extend BatchJobId = tostring(cd.BatchJobId)
| extend DataProjectName =  replace_regex(tostring(cd.DataProjectName), @'-[({]?[a-fA-F0-9]{8}[-]?([a-fA-F0-9]{4}[-]?){3}[a-fA-F0-9]{12}[})]?', '')
| extend EntityName = tostring( cd.EntityName)
| extend ErrorCategory = tostring(cd.ErrorCategory)
| extend ErrorCategory = tostring(cd.ErrorCategory)
| extend ErrorMessage = tostring(cd.ErrorMessage)
| extend ExecutionId = tostring( cd.ExecutionId)
| extend ExecutionMode = tostring(cd.ExecutionMode)
| extend LegalEntity = tostring(cd.LegalEntity)
| extend NumOfStagingNew = tolong(cd.NumOfStagingNew)
| extend NumOfTargetNew = tolong(cd.NumOfTargetNew)
| extend NumOfTargetUpdated = tolong(cd.NumOfTargetUpdated)
| extend SourceOrTarget = cd.SourceOrTarget
| extend StagingColumnName = tostring(cd.StagingColumnName)
| extend StagingErrorCount = toint(cd.StagingErrorCount)
| extend StagingRecId = tolong(cd.StagingRecId)
| extend StagingStatus = tostring(cd.StagingStatus)
| extend TargetErrorCount = toint(cd.TargetErrorCount)
| extend TargetStatus = tostring(cd.TargetStatus)
| extend TotalNumberOfRecords = tolong( cd.TotalNumberOfRecords)
| extend aadTenantId = tostring(cd.aadTenantId)
| extend activityId = tostring(cd.activityId)
| extend environmentId = tostring(cd.environmentId)
| extend eventId = tostring(cd.eventId)
| extend direction = iff(name startswith "DMFExport", "Export",
                     iff(name startswith "DMFImport", "Import", 
                     iff(ExecutionId has "Import" or ExecutionId has "import", "Import", "Export")))
| where isempty( '{EnvironmentIdFilter}') or environmentId == '{EnvironmentIdFilter}'
| where isempty( '{EntityNameFilter}' ) or EntityName == '{EntityNameFilter}'
| where isempty( '{ExecutionIdFilter}' ) or ExecutionId == '{ExecutionIdFilter}'
| where isempty( '{DataProjectFilter}' ) or DataProjectName == '{DataProjectFilter}'
| where isempty( '{ActivityIdFilter}' ) or activityId == '{ActivityIdFilter}'
| project timestamp, name, user_Id, cloud_RoleInstance, 
           BatchJobCaption, BatchJobId, DataProjectName,EntityName, ExecutionId, ExecutionMode,
        LegalEntity, NumOfStagingNew, NumOfTargetNew, NumOfTargetUpdated, SourceOrTarget, StagingColumnName,
        StagingErrorCount,StagingRecId,StagingStatus,TargetErrorCount,TargetStatus,TotalNumberOfRecords, ErrorMessage,
         aadTenantId,activityId,environmentId,eventId,direction
);
allDMFEvents
| where direction == "Export"
| order by timestamp desc
